subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw commit to a public result-level `yield` control in the Plugin SDK, evaluated only after the complete `afterToolCall` finalization lifecycle?
rationale: This creates a durable plugin API and runtime-control contract; code review can identify the lifecycle defect, but only maintainers can approve the permanent public abstraction and ownership boundary.
